title: Frontend Developer
tagline: From your first web page to a production-ready framework app
description: The most direct route into web development. You learn how pages are structured and styled, add behaviour with JavaScript, adopt TypeScript, then pick a modern framework and ship real projects with version control.
audience: Complete beginners and designers who want to build websites and web apps

stages.title: HTML foundations
stages.description: Structure pages with semantic elements, links, images, lists, tables and forms.

stages.title: Styling with CSS
stages.description: Control layout and appearance with the box model, flexbox, grid, responsive design and animations.

stages.title: JavaScript
stages.description: Make pages interactive: language fundamentals, the DOM, events, fetch and asynchronous code.

stages.title: TypeScript
stages.description: Add static types, interfaces and generics so larger codebases stay safe and readable.

stages.title: Pick a framework: Angular or React
stages.description: Build component-based applications with routing, forms, HTTP and state. Angular is the primary track; React is an equally valid alternative.

stages.title: Git and GitHub
stages.description: Track changes, branch, review and publish your work the way teams do.

stages.title: Portfolio projects
stages.description: Apply everything by building three complete projects: a personal site, an interactive dashboard and a framework app that talks to a public API.
stages.topicNote: There is no separate tutorial for this stage. Use the project briefs in the final lessons of the HTML, JavaScript and framework tutorials, publish each project with GitHub Pages and write a short README for every one.

seo.title: Frontend Developer Learning Path
seo.description: A step-by-step roadmap from HTML and CSS through JavaScript and TypeScript to Angular or React, Git and portfolio projects.
